title: 2021 Fall AMC 10A Problem 16
statement:
Consider the function

\[f(x) = |\lfloor x \rfloor| - |\lfloor 1 - x \rfloor|\]

Its graph is symmetric about which of the following? (Here \(\lfloor x \rfloor\) is the greatest integer not exceeding \(x.\))

solutions.text:
For every real \(x,\) \[ \begin{aligned} &f(1-x)=|\lfloor 1-x\rfloor| \\ &\quad {}-|\lfloor x\rfloor|=-f(x). \end{aligned} \]

Equivalently, replacing \(x\) by \(\frac{1}{2}+t\) gives \(f\!\left(\frac{1}{2}-t\right)=-f\!\left(\frac{1}{2}+t\right).\) This is point symmetry about \(\left(\frac{1}{2},0\right).\)

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: The relation is point symmetry, not line symmetry
